mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.movie_code, m.title, m.director, m.genre, m.release_date, m.age_limit, m.running_time FROM final_movie m JOIN schedule s ON m.movie_code = s.movie_code JOIN branch_screen bs ON s.screen_code = bs.screen_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode}

SELECT s.schedule_code, s.movie_code, s.screen_code, s.start_time, bs.screen_name, bs.screen_type, s.start_time + m.running_time/1440 AS end_time FROM schedule s JOIN branch_screen bs ON s.screen_code = bs.screen_code JOIN final_movie m ON s.movie_code = m.movie_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND s.movie_code = #{movieCode} AND TRUNC(s.start_time) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.start_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (movie_code, screen_code, start_time) VALUES (#{movie_code}, #{screen_code}, #{start_time})
mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_code, s.start_time, s.start_time + m.running_time/1440 AS end_time, m.title AS movie_title, bs.screen_name, bs.screen_type FROM schedule s JOIN final_movie m ON s.movie_code = m.movie_code JOIN branch_screen bs ON s.screen_code = bs.screen_code WHERE bs.branch_code = #{branchCode, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND TRUNC(s.start_time) = TO_DATE(#{date, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.start_time

SELECT s.*, bs.screen_name, bs.screen_type, m.title FROM schedule s JOIN branch_screen bs ON s.screen_code = bs.screen_code JOIN final_movie m ON s.movie_code = m.movie_code WHERE s.schedule_code = #{scheduleCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET start_time = #{start_time} WHERE schedule_code = #{schedule_code}
